chunks: In the book of Al-Ḥakam ibn Miskīn, he said: Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said:

Concerning a man who arrives from his journey during the time of a prayer, he said: “If he does not fear the expiry of the time, then let him complete it; and if he fears the expiry of the time, then let him shorten it.”

key_terms.خُرُوجَ الْوَقْتِ: the ending or expiry of the prayer time
key_terms.فَلْيُتِمَّ: let him perform it complete, in full
key_terms.وَقْتِ: the appointed time of the prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a traveler do if he returns home during the time of prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling for a traveler who arrives during the time of salat (prayer). If there is sufficient time remaining, he should perform the prayer in full; but if he fears the prayer time will expire, he should perform it shortened.
